window_precision: exact logged loop boundaries converted to QPC100ns
host_accept_scope: accept_end CPU submission completion; not presentation
wayland_scope: feedback trace subsampled; full frame count unavailable
gpu_d12_scope: GPU copy timestamp duration excluding producer wait; linked to following completed PTS
gpu_d11_scope: bridge GPU copy only; snapshot-local sequence lacks PTS join, not exact motion-window selection

last_input.scope: session last input, not evidence of injected input

task-result.json.timing_origin: fixture start gate after initial 6K capture

droptrace.scope: all-session logged drops only; absence does not establish no drops

timestamp_scope: WGC system-relative timestamps are not generation timestamps; future-of-callback samples retained without reinterpretation
d12_association_warning: Adjacent GPU query/stage/completed lines are diagnostic association, not explicit PTS carried by query; inspect interleaved/multilane logs
